title_sq: Tek Fusha E Aviacionit, Shitet Garsoniere Me Orientim Perfekt!!
description_sq: Tek Fusha E Aviacionit, Shitet Garsoniere Ideale Per Investim !!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin 7 te nje godine 12 kateshe, me ashensor. Prona ka nje siperfaqe totale 38.7 m2. Garsonieria eshte nje opsion Ideal per investim duke marre parasysh zhvillimin e vrullshem qe ka marr zona kohet e fundit dhe rritjen e vleres se qirase. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode.
title_en: In the field of aviation, studio for sale with perfect orientation!!
description_en: In the field of aviation, ideal studio for investment!!! The apartment is located on the 7th floor of a 12-story building, with an elevator. The property has a total surface of 38.7 m2. It is oriented from the West. At the moment, the complex is in the stage of dividing with bricks and is expected to be completed within a period of 20 months. The studio is an ideal option for investment, taking into account the rapid development that the area has received recently and the increase in rental value. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life.
